name: Erbil Citadel
description: Erbil Citadel is a fortified hilltop town in the heart of Erbil, in Iraq's Kurdistan region. It sits on an oval mound about 30 metres high, built up over thousands of years of settlement, with people living here since at least the 5th millennium BC. Its wall of tall 19th-century façades still looks like an impregnable fortress above the modern city.
